class.name: JRPGMover
class.brief_description: One character's step-by-step movement from cell to cell on a map.
class.description: Tracks a character's [member cell], [member direction] and the step it is taking. A step to the next cell takes [method get_steps_per_cell] simulation steps at the character's [member speed] (each level is twice as fast as the one below), and [method advance] runs one simulation step at a time, so movement is the same at any frame rate and on servers. Whether a step can start comes from the map's [JRPGMapCellCache]: the sides of the current and next cells, blocked cells, and looping edges. A step that is not allowed only turns the character. From the moment a step starts, [member cell] is the destination, as events and other characters see it; [method get_position] says where to draw the character on the way. It holds no nodes and reads no input: the game decides when to move a character and draws it where this says.

method.name: advance
method.description: Runs one simulation step of the step under way. Returns [code]true[/code] when that ends the step (the character arrived), [code]false[/code] otherwise or when no step is under way.

method.name: get_offset
method.description: Returns the cell offset one step toward [param direction] takes: up is [code]Vector2i(0, -1)[/code].

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns where to draw the character, in cells: [member cell] when it stands still, or a point on the way from the previous cell, moving evenly. Across a looping edge the previous cell is just outside the map's side.

method.name: get_steps_per_cell
method.description: Returns how many simulation steps (1/60 s each) a step to the next cell takes at [param speed]: 160, 80, 40, 20, 10 and 5 for speeds 1 to 6. Speeds outside 1-6 count as the nearest one.

method.name: is_moving
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a step is under way.

method.name: move
method.description: Turns the character toward [param direction] and, unless a step is already under way, starts a step toward it when [param cell_cache] allows it (any cell inside the map with [member through]). With [param dash] the step is one speed level faster. Returns [code]true[/code] when a step started; when it is not allowed the character only turns. While a step is under way nothing changes.

members.member: The cell the character stands on, or is stepping to. Setting it places the character there at once and ends any step under way.
How fast the character steps, from 1 (slowest) to 6 (fastest); 4 is normal.
If [code]true[/code], the character steps through blocked cells and sides. The map's edges still stop it, except on an axis that loops.
